learning_outcomes.text: Describe how AI assists experiment design, control and data acquisition
Apply surrogate and emulator models to accelerate simulations
Use AI for anomaly detection and triggering in large datasets
Explain uncertainty quantification and calibration for AI in physics
Evaluate reproducibility, validation and the limits of AI-assisted results
Reason about accountability and verification when AI informs physics decisions

integrative_case: A facility deploys an AI trigger to flag rare events in a high-rate detector: calibrate its uncertainty, validate it against simulated and known signals, set thresholds that balance false alarms against missed physics, and define who verifies a flagged discovery before it is announced.

case-based decisions in the integrative case
